title: VTC Rooms Community Members Remove — payload

Response.title: VTC Rooms Community Members Remove — response payload
Response.description: Success response to vtc/rooms/community/members/remove. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/rooms/community/members/remove/0.2#response. The member as recorded, in state `removed`; on `open` and `attributed` rooms the revocation list in force at the room's host, from which the member's credentials are refused; and on a sealed tier the epoch the room advanced to.

revocation.description: On an `open` or `attributed` room: the room's revocation list carrying the withdrawal, as the room's host accepted it. From then on the host refuses every credential the room issued the member before `revokedAt`. Absent on a `private` room, where a member cannot be withdrawn one at a time and their credentials are honoured until `member.validUntil`.

epoch.description: On a sealed tier, the room epoch after the removal.
